After further thought, what was the reasoning for this rapid stat-based difficulty change to DTide?
 It seems like you wished to provide a harder challenge, because the DTide leaderboard was getting crowded, and people were clearing more easily.
 The nature of DTide is a test of your teambuilding skills and resource management. How thin can you stretch your roster and wheels of destiny, and still complete the stages?

It is natural that such a model would get progressively easier because of account progression, and mainly - the overall character count increasing, offering people much more options. 
 These factors were already addressed by the  progressive stat increases with new rotations of DTide, making sure the challenge isn't entirely trivial.

It is my assumption that a5 was used as a balancing framework. It is at the very least the place where we - the players try out new characters and judge their performance.

Now the framework has been changed, and it left the entire system in dismay. Proactive DPS like Mouchette, Lotan: Cetarchon, Doresain(who was already struggling), took a significant hit because they do not have the bases in their kits that would make them shine in prolonged fights, they rely on fast killing. And that is simply impossible when DTide introduces HP values over 10 times bigger than ever before.

Poison and Counter are values that are locked to PLAYER hp, and not enemy HP. With the new difficulties, there are no changes to player hp. Poison and counter values can now soft/hard cap at values that are less than 1% of enemy hp.

This stat inflation hurts the already existing balancing system, and makes players upset because their previous meta investments are suddenly significantly worse.

PLEASE revert these changes and leave the major DTide overhaul  for Arc 3 with character rebalancing, as you clearly do not have the team capacity to provide a fun and reasonable difficulty overhaul to DTide right now.
